source.rationale: The parser entity list is walked twice — once for the scope echo and once to build the token-hint map that decides whether a strict miss collapses. Both walks null-guard the entry, and the hint map's guard is the one that throws if inverted. The turn must still reach the brand-only verdict.
source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED for the team-name DISPLAY fix (captain 2026-08-24). An internal team slug was rendered verbatim into customer WhatsApp copy ("escalate to purchasing_certification team?"); live has been emitting "marketing_promotion_sorento team" at real customers for 4 turns in 8 days. Underscores now render as spaces at the interpolation. The ONLY difference in this expectation is 4 '_' becoming ' ' inside the team token of an escalate sentence - checked character by character (same length, same offsets, every flipped byte between "escalate to" and " team"); no other field, key or value moved. The raw slug is unchanged wherever it is routed on or persisted.
